Class StartupProfileRecorder

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.StartupProfileRecorder
public final class StartupProfileRecorder extends Object
Records the startup profile of an application: the classes a run of its runner jar loaded, in load order, written to a file that is meant to be committed and that the packager embeds for the launcher to preload.

One recording is one training run of the archive, as TrainingSettings describe it, with class-load logging on: the archive is launched once with java -jar, sent the workload and stopped, and every process the run started is gone when it ends. It gets right what a recipe run by hand gets wrong without any sign of it:

  • the log is read once the workload is done and before the application is stopped, so the classes that only a shutdown loads stay out, and the list does not depend on how the JVM is stopped;
  • the classes are recorded in an order that two recordings agree on: the launch sets the common ForkJoin pool's parallelism to zero, so Micronaut's parallel service loading runs on one thread;
  • no JVM option of the machine the build runs on takes part, so no class cache hides the application's classes;
  • an archive that already embeds a profile does not replay it into the new one.

The profile names no build tool: the caller passes the command that records it again, which goes into the header.

Compatibility

This type is stable API for all of 1.x. An input added in a minor release arrives as an overload of record that takes it, and the existing method keeps its signature and passes the input's default. record returns the number of archive classes; other figures go to the BuildLogger, and a minor release that has to return more adds a method rather than change this one's result.

  • Method Details

    • record

      public static int record(Path java, Path runnerJar, TrainingSettings settings, Path workDirectory, Path profile, String rerecordCommand, BuildLogger log) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Launches a runner jar, records the classes it loads up to the end of the training workload and writes them to the profile, replacing it.
      Parameters:
      java - the java executable to record with
      runnerJar - the runner jar to record from, built with the packaging options production uses
      settings - how to reach, exercise and stop the application; its TrainingSettings.jvmArgs() must name no class cache
      workDirectory - a directory of the build's own, which is emptied and becomes the working directory of the launch; the logs of the recording stay in it. It must be new, empty or left by an earlier recording, and must hold neither the runner jar nor the profile
      profile - the profile to write
      rerecordCommand - the command that records the profile again in the caller's build, for the header: one non-blank line
      log - where progress is reported
      Returns:
      the number of archive classes recorded
      Throws:
      IOException - if runnerJar is not a runner jar, the launch fails, the recording holds no class of the archive, or the profile cannot be written
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted; the application has been reaped by then
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null; the message is the name of the parameter, and nothing has been launched or written
      IllegalArgumentException - if rerecordCommand is blank or has a line break, the profile or the runner jar lies inside the work directory, or the work directory holds files that no earlier recording left there
